\textit{Notes.} Coefficients on the log-odds scale; standard errors in parentheses. $^{*}$p$<$0.1; $^{**}$p$<$0.05; $^{***}$p$<$0.01. Firth columns: penalised-likelihood logit (rare events), $p$-values from the penalised likelihood-ratio test. Universe: the place universe of Table~\ref{tab:descriptives}, less places without 2020 vote data (Alaska, Hawaii, and places with no reallocated returns) or without LEHD employment ratio or retail/food job share; every column uses this sample. Full specification: the place adoption model of Table~\ref{tab:crosslevel-adoption} without change in white share, which is not yet built for this sample, plus camera exposure and county also restricted. The omitted race category is everyone not Black, Hispanic or Asian. Camera exposure enters as both margins of the hurdle: whether the place has any mapped camera, and how many. Descriptive associations, not causal effects. \textit{Any restriction} = any confirmed pause, ban, or rejection through September 30, 2026; \textit{Ban} = cancelled, not renewed, banned by ordinance, or cancelled to switch vendor; \textit{Pause} = suspended pending review. Columns 1, 2 and 4: full specification. Column 3: a shorter set (12 covariates) because pauses are fewer; -- marks a covariate not in the model. Column 4: ordinary logit with state fixed effects and state-clustered standard errors; states with no restricting place drop out. Robustness checks in Table~\ref{tab:ban-models-robust}.
\end{minipage}
